fact: The study states that the EU/Civipol CityWeb work concentrated on 11 pilot sites and that since 2024 the experiment was officially extended to all civil status centres, but with little effect in practice; agents interviewed at Bouaflé, Tiébissou and Daloa were reverting to their own local software and databases.
title: Politique(s) de l'état civil: Les enjeux sociopolitiques de l'identification légale en Côte d'Ivoire, en Mauritanie et au Tchad
publisher: PASAS (Banégas, Buchler, Kouyate, Manatouma, Ould Ahmed Salem)
